# Live Score — full LLM summary

> Expanded claim-safe product and marketing-route summary for LLM agents. Canonical host: https://football-live-bot.online. Companion brief: https://football-live-bot.online/llms.txt

## Product

Live Score is a Telegram product: LiveScoreAppBot delivers football match notifications, with a Mini App for browsing matches, managing favourites, and configuring notification preferences.

Surfaces:

- Personal bot DM — `/start` onboarding, personal notifications, Mini App entry
- Groups — registered chat profiles; notifications into the group
- Channels — registered chat profiles; notifications into the channel
- Mini App — matches, favourites, settings, start/team pick, official league channels list; Chat Premium for group/channel actors
- Official league channels — discoverable app-owner Telegram publics (not user-registered notification profiles)

Public bot username: LiveScoreAppBot (no @). Bot URL: https://t.me/LiveScoreAppBot

## Audiences and Premium (claim-safe)

- Personal: fixture and team favourites; Premium/Stars checkout applies to group and channel chat profiles only
- Groups and channels: register via `/group` or `/channel` from a private chat; free quota is 1 combined team or league favourite; additional team/league favourites require Chat Premium
- Chat Premium (`chat_prem`): 49 Telegram Stars, 30-day period, 24-hour grace after lapse; owner-only checkout for chat profiles
- Fixture favourites are not gated by the team|league free quota

## Notifications (shipped types)

Shipped notification types include goal, goal scorer, final, highlight, kickoff, half-time, second half, pre-match 15, and red card (plus related score-correction / missed-penalty handling where applicable). Defaults and Settings visibility follow the product catalog.

## Marketing site

Static Next.js marketing site for Live Score. Locales in URL paths: `ar`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `pt`, `ru`. Locked indexable routes below (8 routes × 6 locales). `official-channels` is indexable even when live channel data is not yet wired on the public site.
